scope.summary: Implement one shared native final-render infrastructure for Cloth and BodyKit, integrated with the existing Handshake Photo Studio capability, with path tracing, render presets, physical cameras/lights, environment, denoise, tone mapping/color management, material/hair/volume support, deterministic reference scenes, and bounded GPU/CPU scheduling.
acceptance_criteria: Render scenes, cameras, lights, environments, integrator/sampling, motion/depth of field, denoise, tone/color, materials, hair, volumes, device budgets, and presets are versioned and inspectable.

Cloth garments and BodyKit bodies, anatomy, skin, hair, pose, camera, light, material, and animation references enter the same TailorRenderJobV1 infrastructure under 13.32 [TAI-BKP-008..009]; neither submodule may fork renderer state, settings, devices, color management, artifacts, or receipts.

Tailor reuses the existing Handshake Photo Studio capability for shared camera/light/color/output/comparison/navigation behavior and does not create a second product, queue, library, or authority named Photo Studio.
Rendering is a cancellable leased job with progress, checkpoints, deterministic seeds, device-loss/VRAM recovery, atomic artifacts, content hashes, and no focus steal.
Backend and Argus tests cover reference scenes, skin/genital/cloth/hair close-ups, dark/light tones, wetness, unsupported nodes, device loss, cancellation, resume, and reproducibility.

The exact TailorSurfaceDescriptor row MT-766 enumerates every route, pane, control author_id, dynamic entity-key rule, action, state, help anchor, permission, undo policy, receipt, and command binding; wildcard-only evidence is rejected.

Applicable blank, loading, populated, stale/conflict, cancelled, failed, retry, permission, keyboard/focus, narrow/4K/DPI, overlap/clipping, and no-focus-steal states are covered by the registry-derived Argus matrix.
scope.risk_if_missed: External viewport captures cannot satisfy literal Daz final-render parity or professional close-up qualification.

surfaces: Shared Tailor render workspace for Cloth and BodyKit
Existing Handshake Photo Studio capability integration

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Professional BodyKit production workflows

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: External viewport captures cannot satisfy literal Daz final-render parity or professional close-up qualification.
GUI, backend, agent, replay, and manual projections may drift if they do not consume the same typed authority.
minimum_controls: One typed owner and exact stable ids are required.
Negative, concurrent, cancellation, recovery, and no-context proofs are required where applicable.
No validator PASS/FAIL is inferred from this pre-activation contract.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.

Use authenticated SurrealDB record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; administrative/root credentials and UI filtering are never the security boundary. PostgreSQL and SQLite access paths are forbidden.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
